infoLinks.content:
Saturday 27 June   
  • From 5.30am to 10.30am, at Hawkesbury River and Cowan, all trains leave from platform 2.

  • If travelling to Cowan, change at Hawkesbury River for a bus.
  • At Cowan, catch a bus to Berowra then change for a train to continue your journey.
  • Trains towards Gosford continue to stop at Cowan.

50CN Hawkesbury River, Cowan, Berowra (in that direction only)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 1 and Thursday 2 July      
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between Cronulla, Waterfall and Sutherland, and between Hurstville and Bondi Junction, to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
43T4 Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
45T4 Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
